content: Composite risk score = 0.50 * MedicalConditionsScore + 0.30 * MedicationAdherenceScore + 0.20 * CoverageScore
0.80-1.00 = Very High Risk / Complex, 0.60-0.79 = High Risk, 0.40-0.59 = Moderate Risk, 0.20-0.39 = Low-Moderate Risk, 0.00-0.19 = Low Risk
Very High Risk: Complex case management. High Risk: Chronic condition coaching. Moderate Risk: Tele-coaching. Low-Moderate Risk: Preventive care. Low Risk: Standard management.
All domain scores must be in [0,1]. Missing scores must be imputed. Same measurement period required.
The composite score integrates coverage, medication adherence, and medical conditions risk scores into a single normalized measure of overall health risk.
